name: clarity-runsheet
description: Root dev orchestrator for Clarity Fleet — docker stack (postgres, redis, api, tcp-listener, ingestion) + web dashboard. Mobile is run separately.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n docker,web -c blue,yellow "npm run docker:up" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend/web install
